extractedText.DOCUMENTS LIST.pdf:
Documents Required for Admission
Applicants are advised to keep the following original documents along with photocopies
ready during the admission process.
Common Documents
SSC (10th) Marksheet & Certificate
HSC (12th) Marksheet or Diploma Marksheet
MHT-CET 2026 Scorecard
JEE Main Scorecard (if applicable)
School Leaving / Transfer Certificate
Domicile / Birth / Nationality Proof
Aadhaar Card
Recent Passport-size Photograph
Candidate Signature
Category Specific Documents
Caste Certificate
Caste Validity Certificate
Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (Applicable Categories)
EWS Certificate
Income Certificate (TFWS / EWS)
PwD Certificate
Defence / Ex-servicemen Certificate (if applicable)
Important Note
Carry both original documents and 2–3 self-attested photocopies during admission.
Ensure all certificates are valid and updated before reporting.
Keep scanned copies of all documents ready for online verification and registration.
